ГАБА.about: Main inhibitory neurotransmitter; oral GABA does not pass the BBB well - sleep/stress is poorly confirmed.
ГАБА.caution: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA). A systematic review of 14 placebo-controlled RCTs found: LIMITED evidence for stress, VERY LIMITED for sleep. The main problem: oral GABA does not cross the blood-brain barrier (BBB). The clinical effect is doubtful. The evidence is mixed and the quality of RCTs is often poor.
ГАБА.food_sources: Fermented and fermented foods contain GABA; how much is absorbed into the brain has not been established.
ГАБА.guidelines: SR 2020 (14 placebo-RCT): stress - limited evidence, sleep - very limited; There are no recommendations on dose/course.
ГАБА.how_to_choose: If you try it, 100–300 mg (research doses); You shouldn’t expect any effect - card D.
mechs: Does not pass the BBB: transporter transfer is limited
The claimed dream has not been confirmed
Peripheral mechanisms of stress response to oral GABA
Neuromodulation from the outside without passing the BBB (periphery/vagus nerve)
Sleep: very limited data, not confirmed (SR 2020)
ГАБА.myths: “Calms as a pharmaceutical drug” - limited evidence, some RCT without effect. “Goes to the brain” - the BBB passes the worst.
ГАБА.name: GABA
ГАБА.onset: The effect is unstable: stress is limited, sleep is very limited (SR 2020).
ГАБА.title: GABA
ГАБА.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
ГАБА.who_needs: Undecided: a review of 14 RCTs provided limited evidence for stress and very limited evidence for sleep; healthy no.
